card.name: Mohobelo
card.tagline: Basotho men's vigorous striding, sliding and leaping dance
card.profile: Mohobelo is the vigorous men's dance of the Basotho of Lesotho, a 'stride, slide and leap' dance marked by high kicks and acrobatic leaps (Music In Africa). Per Music In Africa, in the late 1800s Basotho men guarding outposts in the Maluti Mountains began to add energetic movements and a new style of dancing music, mohobelo, was born in the community of Ha-Molapo in the northern district of Leribe. The music follows a call-and-response pattern in a five-tone scale, the humming 'ho hoba' giving the dance its name; it requires great energy and endurance and is danced mainly in the evening for entertainment (Music In Africa; South Africa Online).
card.insight: Mohobelo travelled to South Africa's gold mines with Basotho migrant labourers in the early 20th century, where inter-mine dance contests produced the European-style brogues-and-bell-bottoms costume still seen at festivals today (Music In Africa).
card.image_significance: The Basotho men's striding/leaping dance. A representative image shows drum-driven communal movement, often in a circle with vivid textiles — Basotho, Lesotho.

observation.setting: an outdoor grass field during a daytime festival or competition with tents, spectators seated on the ground and in chairs, and hills in the background
observation.dancers: a group of men and boys
observation.formation_and_space: a tight linear block formation that moves forward and crouches together, with individual dancers performing solo stepping outside the main group
observation.posture: upright or bent forward from the waist with knees lifting high
observation.footwork: stamping steps with knees raised high and sharp leg extensions to the side or front, synchronized with the rhythmic chanting
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held raised holding long poles or sticks with streamers attached; hands also wave white cloths or tap against hips
observation.hips_and_torso: torso leans forward or stays upright, with stable hips and powerful leg and knee drives
observation.levels_jumps_turns: dancers crouch low to the ground in a cluster, then rise to stand and perform high knee lifts and turns
observation.costume_and_props: white sleeveless shirts or vests, dark trousers with white decorative panels or stripes, and long sticks/poles with white streamers attached held in the hands
observation.cannot_infer: exact acoustic musical accompaniment beyond vocals is unclear; footwork details during low crouches are partially occluded by the group formation
